name: ModelVariant843_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant843_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (while the ambient light dims, orbs and comets leave two model parts for jittered points on the opposing slot, the orbs spinning and flickering as they fly while optional sparks flash from the model; each arrival opens into a fading four-petal burst and once the last of both has landed the light comes back); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the orbs and comets and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once the first orb has arrived, 1 once when the last orb and comet have arrived after the emission end, 2 once the last orb and comet have faded and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-860 and 957 images build it from the same source through french_model_variant/variant860_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
